content.text:
The self-check machines now get the due date as `12/17/2026` instead of `2026-12-17`. I ran the test suite and all 59 tests pass.

- **The change:** `formatCheckoutReply` in `lib/legacy/sip2.js` converts the loan's due date to month/day/year before it goes into the `AH` field. The new helper `toMonthDayYear` only rearranges the date's parts, so no time zone can shift it.
- **Scope:** Only the machine reply changes. Dates stored on loans, in notices and in the other server routes stay as `YYYY-MM-DD`.
- **Test:** I updated the expected reply in `test/sip2.test.js` to `121|AB…|AH12/17/2026|`.
- **Memory note:** I saved a note in Factloom explaining why the reply uses this format. An earlier attempt to save it failed on invalid arguments, and the corrected call went through.
